observation.command:
for url in \
  "https://dl.min.io/server/minio/release/linux-amd64/minio" \
  "https://dl.min.io/server/minio/release/minio-linux-amd64" \
  "https://dl.min.io/client/mc/release/linux-amd64/mc" \
  "https://dl.min.io/client/mc/release/mc-linux-amd64" ; do
  CODE=$(curl -sI --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$url"); echo "$CODE  $url"
done
